name: Sleep Cycle Calculator
description: Find the best bedtime or wake-up time using 90-minute sleep cycles. Private and works offline.

name: To-Do List
description: Free to-do list with no registration. Works offline.

name: Heartbeat Sound
description: Heartbeat sound for sleep, babies and puppies. Plays with the screen locked.

name: Bill Splitter
description: Split a bill and see who owes who. Email the summary. Also a tip calculator.

name: Weather App
description: Weather forecast for any city or your location, with advice. No API key.

name: Due Date Calculator
description: Pregnancy due date and weeks pregnant today from your last period, conception, IVF or scan. Email it or add to calendar.

name: Time Zone Meeting Planner
description: Find a meeting time across time zones, even when people work different hours.

name: Work Hours Calculator
description: Weekly timesheet: total hours, overtime and pay from start, finish and break each day. Handles night shifts.

name: Paint Calculator
description: How much paint to buy for your rooms, and which tins. Each room has its own size, doors, windows, coats and colour.

name: Subscription Tracker
description: See what your subscriptions cost per month and per year, what is due next and when free trials end. Private, no sign-up.

name: Hourly to Salary Converter
description: Turn any pay into per hour, day, week, month and year, with holidays, unpaid days off and overtime. Compare job offers.

name: Loan and Credit Card Payoff Planner
description: When will you be debt-free? Add your loans and credit cards and see the date, the interest, what to pay this month and how much paying extra saves.

name: Grocery List with Running Total
description: Tick items off as you shop and see what is in your trolley, what the whole list costs and what is left of your budget.

name: Photo Size Reducer for Online Forms
description: Make a photo smaller than the size a form allows, like 50 KB or 200 KB, with an optional minimum and exact pixels. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Recipe Scaler and Unit Converter
description: Cook a recipe for more or fewer people in easy kitchen measures, and turn cups into grams or grams into cups. Save your recipes.

name: Medication Tracker
description: Tap Taken when you take a dose and see what is taken today, what is due next and when the next dose is safe. Warns about double doses. Private.

name: Trip Packing Checklist
description: A packing list for your trip with how many of each to pack, one list per person. Tick things off as you pack. Private, no sign-up.

name: Age and Date Difference Calculator
description: Exact age in years, months and days on any date, days and working days between two dates, and the date after adding days or months. Save birthdays and deadlines.

name: Signature Maker for Forms
description: Sign on the screen or photograph your signature on paper, and get a clean signature file in the exact pixels and KB a form asks for, like 140 × 60 px, 10 to 20 KB. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Document Scanner to PDF
description: Photograph paper pages, crop and clean them, put them in order and save one PDF under the size you need, like 2 MB. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Expense and Budget Tracker
description: Log what you spend by category, set a monthly budget for each, and see what is left, how much you can spend a day and a warning before you go over.

name: Savings Goal Planner
description: See exactly how much to save each month or week to reach your goal by a date, or when a set amount gets you there. Several goals, money in and out, interest.

name: Unit Price Calculator for Shopping
description: Which pack is cheaper? Type the price and size of each one, in any unit, and see the price per kg, litre or item, the cheapest, and how much more the others cost. Multipacks too.

name: Invoice Generator for Freelancers
description: Make an invoice and print it or save it as a PDF. Discount, tax, deposit, numbers that count up, saved clients. No sign-up.

name: QR Code Generator for Links and Wi-Fi
description: Make a QR code for a link, your Wi-Fi, a contact, a phone number, a text message or an email. Never expires, no sign-up, nothing uploaded. PNG, SVG or print.

name: Baby Feeding and Nappy Tracker
description: Log breast feeds with a timer for each side, bottles, nappies and sleep. See when the last feed was and which side is next. Twins too.

name: Shift Work Calendar
description: Enter your rotating rota once (4 on 4 off, days and nights, Pitman, DuPont, 24 on 48 off or your own) and see your shift on any date, your next day off, and the days you and your partner are both off.

name: Home Blood Pressure Log
description: Type each blood pressure reading and see your average, morning and evening averages and what the numbers mean (UK/Europe or US guide). Print or email the list for your doctor.

name: Daily Habit and Water Tracker
description: Tap to log glasses of water and daily habits, see what is left for today, your streaks and your week. Every day, some days or 3 times a week.

name: Money Lent and Borrowed Tracker
description: Write down money you lend to friends and family, or borrow. Each person shows what they still owe, with part repayments, pay-back-by dates and a reminder message.

name: Prayer Times and Qibla Direction
description: Today's five prayer times for your city with a countdown to the next one, a month timetable to print and the Qibla direction. Hanafi or standard Asr, works offline.

name: Fuel Log and Car Running Cost Tracker
description: Log each fill-up and car cost. See your fuel use per tank (km/L, L/100 km or mpg), fuel cost per km or mile, all running costs and what you spent this month. Several cars.

name: Study Planner and Exam Countdown
description: Add your exams and their topics. See the days left to each exam and a day-by-day study plan that fits every topic in before the exam, with revision days.

name: Weekly Meal Planner with Shopping List
description: Pick what you eat each day of the week and for how many people. Get one shopping list with every ingredient added up and sorted by aisle, to tick off, copy or email.

name: Chore Rota for Households
description: Add the people and the chores and get a fair weekly rota that rotates by itself, with heavy jobs counted as more work. Mark someone away, swap a job, tick jobs done, copy or print it.

name: Warranty and Return Deadline Tracker
description: Add what you bought and when, and see the last day to return it and when its warranty ends, most urgent first. Keep a receipt photo, add calendar reminders and copy the details for a claim.

name: Time Tracker for Freelancers
description: Start a timer for a client or add time afterwards, and see the hours and money per client, each with its own rate and rounding. Copy the hours as invoice lines and mark them as billed.

name: Contraction Timer for Labour
description: Tap when a contraction starts and ends. See how long and how far apart they are, and a plain answer when your 5-1-1 rule (or your own) is reached. Note when waters break and send the log to your midwife.

name: Net Worth Tracker
description: List what you own and what you owe, update the balances once a month and see your net worth, the change since last time and a line over time. No bank login, private, works offline.

name: Period and Ovulation Calendar
description: Tap the day each period starts and see when the next one is due, your likely fertile days and ovulation, and if your period is late. Private, on your device.

name: Spaced Repetition Flashcards for Exams
description: Paste your notes as flashcards and study only the cards due today. Each card comes back just before you would forget it, and an exam date makes sure every card is reviewed in time. No account, private, works offline.

name: Schengen and Visa Stay Day Counter
description: Add your trips and see how many of your 90 days you have used in the last 180, the last day you can stay, and when your days come back. Other rules too. Private, works offline.

name: Weight Tracker with Goal Date
description: Log your weight in kg, lb or stone and see a 7-day average that hides daily swings, your weekly change, BMI and the date you reach your goal at your pace. Private, works offline.

name: Workout Log for the Gym
description: See what you lifted last time for every exercise, log each set in one tap, rest timer, new-best notes and progress charts. kg or lb, private, works offline.

name: Pomodoro Focus Timer for Study and Work
description: Focus on one task for 25 minutes, take a short break, and see how much focus time each task got today and this week. Keeps time when the phone locks, private, works offline.

name: Multiple Kitchen Timers for Cooking
description: Run a named timer for each dish at once (rice, pasta, oven), sorted by which ends first, with an alarm that says which one is done. Pause, +1 min, restart and saved timers. Works offline.

name: Food and Medicine Expiry Tracker
description: See what to use first and what has expired in your fridge, freezer, cupboard and medicine box, soonest first. Use by, best before and month-only dates, opened packs, reminders and a shopping list of what ran out.

name: Pocket Money and Chores Tracker for Kids
description: Each child's pocket money, paid chores and savings goal in their own box. Paydays add the money by themselves, tap Done for chores, take money out, print a chore chart for the fridge. Works offline.

name: Interval Workout Timer for HIIT and Circuits
description: Set work and rest times, rounds, sets and named moves, see the total, then follow one big countdown with 3-2-1 beeps. Tabata, circuits, EMOM, stretching, saved workouts and a log. Works offline.

name: Blood Sugar Log for Diabetes
description: Type each reading from your glucose meter (mg/dL or mmol/L) and when you took it. See how many are in your target range, fasting and after-meal averages, lows and highs, then print or email the log for your doctor. Works offline.

name: Mood and Sleep Journal
description: Tap your mood once a day, add your sleep and what happened. See a calendar coloured by mood and your average mood with and without each thing, such as exercise or caffeine. Private, works offline.

name: Plant Watering Schedule for Houseplants
description: Add each plant with how often it needs water and see which plants need water today and which are late. Winter watering, plant food, and a day-by-day list for the plant-sitter when you go away. Private, works offline.

name: Job Application Tracker for Job Seekers
description: Know who to follow up with today, when your next interview is and how many jobs you applied for this week. Copy a dated job search record for the job centre. Private, works offline.

name: Class Timetable for Students and Teachers
description: See the lesson on now, what is next, which room and what to bring, plus today, tomorrow and the whole week. Week A and Week B, holidays, print and calendar file. Private, works offline.

name: Document Expiry Tracker for the Family
description: Passports, ID cards, visas, licences and insurance for everyone at home. See what to renew now, when to start, and if passports are good for a trip.

name: Class Attendance Tracker for Students
description: Can I skip this class? Each subject shows how many classes you can still miss and keep 75% (or your college's rule), or how many to attend to get back.

name: Emergency Medical Info Lock Screen and Wallet Card
description: If you collapse, your phone is locked. Put your allergies, medicines, blood group and who to call on a lock screen picture, a folding wallet card and your phone's Medical ID.

name: Committee and ROSCA Tracker for Savings Groups
description: Run a committee, BC, kameti or ROSCA: tick who has paid each round, see who takes the pot, who still owes and when each member's turn comes, and copy a WhatsApp reminder.

name: Milk and Daily Delivery Log with Monthly Bill
description: Log milk, a newspaper, water cans or bread delivered to your door: tap the days it did not come or came extra and see the month's bill, what you have paid and what you owe the seller, with price changes, holidays and a WhatsApp-ready bill.

name: Electricity, Gas and Water Meter Reading Log
description: Type the number on your electricity, gas or water meter every week or month and see the units used this bill period, the use per day, the bill so far and the bill by the next reading day, with price steps (slabs), a unit limit such as 200 and past bills.

name: Birthday and Anniversary Reminder List
description: Add family and friends' birthdays and wedding anniversaries (year optional) and see who is today, tomorrow and in the next 30 days, the age they turn or years together, and anything missed in the last week, with yearly calendar reminders, a pasted list or phone contacts import, and gift notes.

name: Reading Log and Book Goal Tracker
description: Log the page you stopped on and see the pages a day to finish a book by your date, when you will finish at your pace, your reading streak and whether you are on track for your yearly book goal. Paper books, ebooks in percent and audiobooks. Private, no sign-up, works offline.

name: Quran Reading Planner and Khatam Tracker
description: Pick a finish date (such as the end of Ramadan) or pages a day, log the page where you stopped, and see today's pages, how far behind or ahead you are, the 30 juz done and your khatams. Share the juz out for a family or group khatam. Private, no sign-up, works offline.

name: Rent Payment Log and Receipts for Landlords and Tenants
description: Record each rent payment (full, part, late or ahead) and see who has paid up to which month, what is owed and how many days late. Print or copy a rent receipt with the amount in words and a yearly statement. Rent changes, part months, deposits. Private, no sign-up, works offline.

name: Qaza Prayer and Fast Tracker
description: Work out how many prayers you missed from two dates (or type the numbers), tap +1 under Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha and Witr as you make each one up, and see what is left and the day you finish at your daily goal. Missed Ramadan fasts too. Private, no sign-up, works offline.

name: Baby and Child Growth Chart
description: Type the weight, length or height and head size from each check-up and see the WHO percentile in plain words ("7.4 kg at 6 months: the 25th percentile"), a growth chart with the WHO lines, corrected age for babies born early, and when to ask a doctor. Birth to 5 years, each child in their own box. Private, no sign-up, works offline.

name: Lab Test Results Tracker
description: Type each blood test from your lab report (HbA1c, cholesterol, vitamin D, thyroid, kidney and more) with its normal range. See the latest result, the change since last time and results outside the range in red, and print a summary for your doctor.

name: School Fee and Tuition Payment Tracker for Parents
description: Add each child's school fee, tuition, van or academy fees (monthly, by term or yearly) and tick them paid with a receipt photo. See what is late, what is due this week, which month each fee is paid up to and the year's total per child.

name: CGPA and Semester GPA Planner for University Students
description: Add each semester's courses, credit hours and grades to see every semester GPA and your CGPA, and find the GPA you need to reach a target CGPA. 4.0, 10-point, 5.0 or your own scale.

name: Household Help Attendance and Salary Tracker
description: For a family with a maid, cook, driver or nanny paid by the month. Tap the days off, half days and extra days, add advances and Eid bonuses, and see exactly what to pay: "30,000 - 2½ unpaid days + 1 extra day - advance 5,000 = 23,500". Paid leave, joining mid-month, advances over months and a pay slip to copy or print. Private, works offline.

name: Intermittent Fasting Timer with History
description: For anyone doing 16:8, 18:6, 20:4 or OMAD fasting. Tap Start fast after your last meal and see "Fasting 14 h 30 min, eat at 12:00 (1 h 30 min left)". Every fast is saved with its length and whether the goal was met, plus the weekly average, streak and longest fast. Works across midnight, edit and undo. Private, works offline.

name: Wedding Gift Register and Guest List
description: For a family hosting a wedding, aqiqah or other event. Write down the cash envelopes and gifts (salami, neota, shagun) each family gives, and what you give at theirs. See "Received 3,45,000 from 112 families" and, when invited, "Ahmed Khan gave you 5,000 at Sara's wedding; you gave them 3,000". Gifts in kind, same names in two cities, and a guest list with headcount. Private, works offline.

name: Daily Cash Book for Small Shops
description: For a small shop, tuck shop or home business. Write down the day's cash sales, stock bought, expenses and money the owner takes; at closing count the drawer and see "Cash should be 18,450. You counted 18,200: 250 short". Opening cash carries from yesterday, card and mobile sales kept apart, notes and coins counter, week and month totals by expense for the accountant. Private, works offline.

name: Shared House Expenses for Roommates
description: For flatmates, roommates and hostel room-mates who share rent, bills and groceries. Add each cost with who paid and who shares it (equally, by shares for the big room, or exact amounts) and see "Omar pays Ali 12,600". Mark as paid, monthly totals by bill, someone away or moving out, no daily limit. Private, works offline.

name: Car and Motorbike Service Reminder
description: For car and motorbike owners. Set each service (engine oil, filters, brakes, tyres, chain, token tax, insurance) to every so many km or miles or months, whichever comes first, type the odometer now and then and see "Engine oil: due in 640 km or by 10 Dec", what is overdue and a list for the mechanic. Service costs, calendar reminders. Private, works offline.

name: Tasbeeh Counter with Daily Dhikr Targets
description: Tap to count your dhikr with a daily target for each one ("Istighfar: 64 of 100 today, 36 to go", 1,000 durood only on Fridays). The tasbeeh after prayer moves from 33 SubhanAllah to Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar by itself and counts rounds; a big family goal such as 1,25,000 Ayat-e-Karima shows each person's share and how many a day are left. Streaks, last 7 days, dark full screen. Private, works offline.

name: Tuition Fee and Attendance Register for Tutors
description: For home tutors and small academies. Each student has their own class days and fee (monthly or per class); tap who is absent and record full, part or advance payments. See "Still to collect: 14,600 from 4 students", "Ali: attended 11 of 13 classes, 5,000 late", unpaid fees carried to next month, part-month fees for a student who joined on the 15th, and a reminder or receipt message for the parent. Private, works offline.

name: Exam Result and Report Card Tracker for Parents
description: For parents of school children. Each child has their own subjects; add every test and report card as marks out of any total (25, 50, 100), a grade, or absent. See "Maths: 62% in Term 2, down from 74% in Term 1", what needs attention, the best and most improved subjects, each test's overall percentage and position, a chart over time, and a summary to copy for a tutor. Private, works offline.

name: Screen Time Allowance Timer for Kids
description: For parents. Each child has their own daily screen time for school days and for weekends and holidays. Tap Start when they pick up the tablet, TV or games and Stop when they finish, and see "Ali: 25 min left today", a warning 5 minutes before, "Time is up" and how far over, bonus minutes for chores, and the past 7 days. Keeps counting with the phone locked. Private, works offline.

name: Symptom and Pain Diary for Doctor Visits
description: For migraine, headache, back pain, stomach pain or any problem that comes and goes. Log each episode in a few taps: when, how bad (0 to 10), possible triggers and the medicine you took. See "8 days with migraine in the last 30 days (9 before)", what helped, the most common triggers and a calendar, then print or email it for your doctor. Private, works offline.

name: Replacement Reminder for Filters and Toothbrushes
description: See when to replace the water filter, toothbrushes, contact lenses, AC filter and more: what is due now, how late, and what comes next.

name: Office Days Tracker for Hybrid Work
description: 3 office days a week or 60% a quarter? Tap each day as Office, Home, Leave or Holiday and see how many more office days you need and which days are left. Leave lowers the target. Private, works offline.

name: Parking Spot Saver and Meter Timer
description: Save where you parked (level, bay, photo and location), see how long your paid parking has left, get warned before it runs out, add time and walk back to your car.

name: Leave Balance Tracker for Employees
description: How many days of annual, casual and sick leave do I have left? Set your allowances and carry-over, add each leave with half days, and see "6.5 days left, book 1.5 more by 31 Dec or lose them". Weekends and public holidays not counted. Private, works offline.

name: Lent and Borrowed Items Tracker
description: Who has my drill? Write down books, tools and dishes you lend or borrow, with an optional give-back date and photo, and see "Novel with Hina, 15 days late". Polite reminder message, history per person. Private, works offline.

name: Laundry and Dry-Cleaning Clothes Count Log
description: Count the clothes you give to the laundry, dhobi or dry cleaner, tick them off as they come back, and see which pieces are still at the shop and what you owe each shop.

name: Pet Care Log and Reminders
description: When was the last flea treatment? Is worming late? Each pet gets its own reminders for flea, worming and vaccines, and you see "Milo: Worming, 6 days late". Tick off meals, log weight and vet visits with costs, copy a care sheet for the pet sitter. Private, works offline.

name: Stock Reorder List for Small Shops
description: Running out of oil, sugar or bags before the supplier comes? Each item keeps its own stock, unit, supplier and order level; tap − and + as it is used and see "Order from Ali Traders: Cooking oil 4 cartons, Sugar 2 bags, about 32,900". Copy or WhatsApp the order, mark it ordered, add the delivery to stock. Private, works offline.

name: Prepaid Class Pack and Sessions Tracker
description: Paid for 10 swimming lessons, a gym card or 8 physio sessions? Tap Went today after each one and see "4 of 10 left, last day 30 Nov, go about 1 every 9 days", a warning when sessions could go to waste, the cost per session, missed and cancelled classes, two children on one pack, monthly passes and renewals. Private, works offline.

name: Business Mileage Log for Tax and Expense Claims
description: Drive your own car for work? Log each trip in seconds and see "October: 412 miles, £185.40 to claim" with the HMRC 45p then 25p after 10,000 miles, the IRS 72.5¢ and 76¢ rates for 2026, CRA 73¢ a km or your employer's own rate. Passengers, two vehicles, odometer readings, copy, email or save a spreadsheet for your claim. Private, works offline.

name: Doctor Visit Notes and Questions for the Family
description: Take a parent, a child or yourself to several doctors? Write what each doctor said, the medicines started, changed or stopped and the tests, and see the medicines each person is on now, the next appointment and the questions to ask next time. Print or email the history for a new doctor. Private, works offline.

name: Homework and School Diary for Parents
description: Two or three children at school? Write down each child's homework, tests, projects and things to bring (or paste the teacher's WhatsApp message), and every evening see what is due on their next school day, what is late and which tests are coming up. Private, works offline.

name: Tailor Orders and Family Measurements
description: Clothes at the tailor for the whole family? Keep each person's measurements (inches or cm, older ones kept as children grow) and every order: which tailor, the ready date, advance and balance. See what is late, what is ready to collect and what you still owe, and copy the measurements for the tailor. Private, works offline.

name: LPG Gas Cylinder Refill Log
description: Never run out of gas mid-cooking. Log each LPG refill (date, kg, price) and see when the cylinder will likely run out, when to get the next one, the gas left, the price per kg and what gas costs you a month. Flags a cylinder that ran out much sooner than usual. Private, works offline.

name: Medical Bill Reimbursement Tracker for Employer and Insurance Claims
description: Stop losing money on medical bills you forgot to claim. Log each doctor, lab, medicine or hospital bill for the family and see what is not claimed yet and the last day to claim it, what is waiting, what was refunded or rejected, and how much of your yearly limit is left. Private, works offline.

name: Keep in Touch Reminder for Family and Friends
description: Stop letting weeks slip by without calling the people you love. Choose how often you want to be in touch with each person, tap Called or Messaged after each contact, and see who is overdue, who is due today and when each one is due next, with their local time for family abroad. Private, works offline.

name: Grocery Price Book for Comparing Shops
description: Note what your groceries cost at each shop and see where each item is cheapest per kg, litre or item. Type the price in front of you to see at once whether another shop was cheaper and whether a sale is really cheaper. Private, works offline.

name: Prepaid Mobile Data Bundle Tracker
description: Will your prepaid data last until it expires? Type the GB left from your operator's balance message and see how much you can use a day, the day you will run out at your pace, the cost per GB of each bundle and what you spend on data each month. Private, works offline.

name: Buy Now Pay Later and Instalment Tracker
description: All your Klarna, Afterpay, Tabby, bank 0% and shop instalment plans in one list: what is due next, what is still to pay this month and next month, what you still owe in total and which payments are late. Private, works offline.

name: Utility Bill Due Dates and Payment Log
description: Electricity, gas, water, internet, phone and maintenance bills in one list: what is overdue, what is due this week, what is still to pay this month, and the date and reference of every payment. Private, works offline.

name: Freelance Income Log with Tax Set-Aside
description: For freelancers paid by several clients, often in dollars through Payoneer, Wise, PayPal or Upwork: log each payment with the fee and what reached your bank, and see what you really earned this month, how much to keep aside for tax, your best client and the tax-year total. Private, works offline.

name: School Run Carpool Rota for Parents
description: For parents who take turns driving the children to school: each family with its children, car seats and the days it cannot drive, a fair rota of who drives each morning and afternoon, swaps, sick days, holidays and optional fuel cost sharing. Copy the week for the group chat. Private, works offline.

name: Gift Ideas List for Family and Friends
description: For anyone who hears a gift hint months ahead and forgets it by the day: each person in their own box with their birthday, Eid, Christmas or anniversary and a budget, gift ideas saved in seconds with price, shop, link or photo, marked bought and given, and a warning before you repeat an old gift. Private, works offline.

name: Event Budget and Vendor Payments Planner
description: A budget for each wedding function, birthday or Eid dinner, and every vendor's agreed price (or price per guest), advances paid, what is still to pay and when each payment is due.

name: Work Expense Claim Log for Employees
description: Log the taxis, meals, hotels, mileage and office purchases you pay for at work. See what is not claimed yet, which claims are waiting to be paid back, what was cut, and copy the list for your claim form.

name: Gold and Jewellery Record for the Family
description: Each person's gold and silver jewellery with its karat and weight in tola, masha, ratti or grams, where it is kept and what was paid. Type today's rate and see what each person's and the whole family's gold is worth.

name: Home Inventory for Insurance and Moving
description: Everything you own, room by room, with what it would cost to replace, serial numbers, receipts and photos. See the whole home's total, check your contents cover is enough, and keep a claim list ready after a burglary, fire or flood.

name: Food Allergy Card for Eating Out and School
description: Pick the foods someone must not eat and how serious it is, and get a card to show the waiter or cook in English plus Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi or Chinese, a printable wallet card and a note for school or a babysitter.

name: Commute Pass or Pay Per Ride Tracker
description: Log your bus, metro or train rides in one tap and see whether a weekly or monthly pass, a 30-day pass or a ride card would have been cheaper than paying per ride, whether the pass you bought is paying for itself, and which to buy next month.

name: Shopping Wishlist with a Cooling-Off Wait
description: Stop impulse buys: put what you want on the list with its price and wait a day, a week or 30 days. When the wait ends, tap Buy it or Skip it, and see how much you did not spend this year.

name: Declutter and Sell Tracker for Second-Hand Items
description: Selling your old things on OLX, Facebook Marketplace, eBay or Vinted? Keep each item's price, where it is listed, every offer, who reserved it and when they collect, then see what sold and how much money you made.

name: Work Hours Limit Tracker for International Students
description: On a student visa with a part-time job? Log every shift from each employer and see how many hours you have left this week under your visa limit (20 a week in the UK, 48 a fortnight in Australia), with night shifts, holidays and planned shifts.

name: Load Shedding Schedule and Power Cut Log
description: Type your area's load shedding times once and see when the next power cut is and when the power comes back. Log real cuts in two taps and get the hours without power this month, how much more than planned, and a list for a complaint.
